# openinfra_replication (Resource)

Bidirectional replication between two databases (multi-master, last-write-wins).

This is **experimental**: convergence under concurrent conflicting writes is not yet proven by a formal harness. See the open-infra README's maturity section.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `site_a` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site_a))
- `site_b` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site_b))
- `tables` (List of String) Bare table names replicated both ways. Each must exist on both sites with the same primary key.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `origin_column` (String) Origin marker used for loop prevention and as the last-write-wins tiebreak.
- `version_column` (String) Hybrid-logical-clock column added by table preparation, used for last-write-wins.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `phase` (String)
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--site_a"></a>
### Nested Schema for `site_a`

Required:

- `database` (String)
- `engine` (String) One of `postgres`, `mysql`, `mariadb`, `sqlserver`.
- `host` (String) Hostname or Service name.
- `name` (String) Short site id used as the origin marker, e.g. `a` or `east`. Must be unique across the pair.
- `password_secret_ref` (Attributes) Secret holding the password. The password itself is never in this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site_a--password_secret_ref))
- `username` (String)

Optional:

- `port` (Number) Defaults to `5432`.
- `schema` (String) Defaults to `public`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.

<a id="nestedatt--site_a--password_secret_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `site_a.password_secret_ref`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `key` (String) Defaults to `password`.
